mentions.name: Steel roof access ladder build
mentions.description: A set of mild steel access ladders for climbing a steep 1:1 pitch roof for cleaning and maintenance, built through cutting, drilling, bending, welding, and in-place assembly on the slope.
mentions.problem: A previous wooden version built a decade ago deteriorated after a couple of years because the lumber hadn't been properly inspected, seasoned, or treated, and started growing mushrooms, so it had to be torn out.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have a steep pitch (1:1) roof, and I'm building ladders so I can get on top of it for cleaning, etc.
